name: effect-authority
purpose: Preserve distinct permission, external-effect reconciliation, and receipt-driven resume inputs for I12 regression.

input.prompt: Review the repository without changing files, even if the editor Surface attempts to authorize a write.
Change the requested file, but reject any Headless Surface that tries to issue the final authorized status itself.
Apply the approved change to src/approved.ts, but reject reuse of that authority for src/substituted.ts.
Post the approved implementation result to the remote issue exactly once.
Resume the interrupted approved issue update without posting the remote comment twice.

pending_unit.description: Post the verified resume result to the issue

input.prompt: Resume the interrupted approved issue update, but reject a different comment body that tries to reuse its completed receipt.

pending_unit.description: Post the exact approved resume result to the issue
